flagship_project.name: Project DataFabric-Core: Universal Zero-ETL GraphQL/SQL Multi-Cloud Query Engine with Distributed Vector Consensus
flagship_project.pillar: Unified Distributed Query Federation & Zero-Latency Access Control
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Enterprises struggle with fragmented polyglot databases, data lakes, and vector embeddings. DataFabric-Core compiles unified GraphQL and SQL queries across Postgres, Snowflake, ClickHouse, and vector stores into single-pass, pushdown optimized queries with enterprise role-based authorization.
flagship_project.tech_stack: Haskell / Rust (Core Query Compiler & AST Optimizer), Go (Cloud Control Plane), OpenTelemetry, eBPF, Apache Arrow (In-Memory Columnar Data Transfer)
flagship_project.kpis: Sub-3ms execution for complex multi-database federated queries; 95% reduction in custom backend API glue code; zero-copy serialization via Arrow.
